skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it.

Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Corrosion damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it. Then, deals AoE Corrosion damage equivalent to 60% ATK to the target and all enemies within a 3 tile radius of it, and and pulls them towards the center by 1 tile.
If this skill successfully kills a target, reduces the cooldown of Devastating Drift by 1 turn, and increases Contamination Gauge by 2 points.
If no targets are killed, applies 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion for 2 turns.

Selects a tile within a 8 tile radius, and deals AoE Corrosion damage equivalent to 90% ATK to all enemies within a 3 tile radius of the specified tile, and applies Toxic Infiltration for 2 turns. Increases damage dealt by 15% if the enemy already has Toxic Infiltration.

Selects a tile within a 4 to 8 tile cross shaped radius, and lands on the specified tile. Deals AoE Corrosion damage equivalent to 100% ATK to all enemies within a 5 tile width of the path, and gains 6 tiles of Extra Movement. If this skill kills 2 or more target, this skill can be immediately used again. This effect can be triggered only once.

Klukai is immune to all Control Type effects. Applies 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion for 2 turns to the target when dealing damage with active attacks, and gains 1 stack of Competitiveness after skill usage.
For each instance of Corrosion damage dealt by Klukai's active attacks or other allies, increases Contamination Gauge by 1 point. For every 3 points of Contamination Gauge gained, decreases cooldown of Devastating Drift by 1 turn.
